# Scene owner corpus

`producer.json` is generated by the actual Lux calibrated PCM analyzer, director,
existing authority, service snapshot and leased preview command handler. Its director
elapsed clock is injected; fixture output remains null/disarmed. It contains initial,
RGB/intensity active, source-loss held and nonmutating owner-preview cases. This is
software contract evidence, not an acoustic or physical synchronization claim.

Reproduce: `GP_SCENES_FIXTURE_OUT=tests/fixtures/scenes cargo test --locked --lib scene_producer_authority_loss_and_real_command_preview`.
